video:video.video:title: The US government has suspended Tata, Cognizant, Infosys, Wipro, Capgemini and HCL from the perman
video:video.video:description: The US government has suspended Tata, Cognizant, Infosys, Wipro, Capgemini and HCL from the permanent labour certification program, known as PERM. The program is an important step for companies sponsoring eligible foreign workers for US permanent residency, commonly known as a green card. The decision means affected companies face restrictions on using the PERM process for employment-based green card cases. This could create uncertainty for foreign employees who are currently seeking permanent residency through their employers, particularly workers in the technology and consulting sectors. The suspension does not mean these companies are banned from operating in the United States, nor does it automatically cancel workers’ existing visas or green cards. The impact will mainly concern the companies’ ability to sponsor workers through the permanent labour certification process.
